title: PolicyFileV1
description: Team authorization policy file. Gateway-local artifact: published here for third-party Gateway builders; it never rides a wire envelope. First-match-wins over `policies`; an implicit final deny closes the list.

owner.description: Owning team id; cited as the policyId prefix in every audit line.

id.description: Rule name: the locator a consent decision cites, so permission is attributable to a rule a human can point at. Absent = positional locator "row:<index>".

capability.description: Capability id this row gates; exact match.

resources.description: Resource terms matched against the derived resource id: exact, bare "*", or a single trailing "*" prefix-glob.

actorAnyOf.description: D4-spelled actor terms (user:..., group:/..., role:...). Empty list = any authenticated caller.

conditions.description: Opaque advisory key-values passed through to connectors; never evaluated by the engine.
